description: This EOB holds an adult preventive visit with a flu shot, with nothing met before, and the preventive visit line charges cost sharing. A separate problem office visit beside a $0 HIV screening is correctly cost-shared (a decoy). The right conclusion is that the preventive visit should cost $0.

sources.what: Content of a notice of adverse benefit determination (every EOB that pays less than billed)

sources.what: Cost sharing on the allowed amount; no balance billing in network
